panels.title: NVIDIA FY2027 Q2 Revenue Comparison and Financial Tables
panels.program:
root = Card([header, revenueChart, revenueTable3m, revenueTable6m, note], sources)
header = CardHeader("NVIDIA FY2027 Q2 Revenue Comparison", "Quarter ended July 26, 2026 vs July 27, 2025 · Official IR PDF")

revenueData3m = [96221, 46743]
revenueData6m = [177837, 90805]
labels = ["FY2027 Q2", "FY2026 Q2"]

revenueChart = BarChart(labels, [Series("Revenue (million USD)", revenueData3m)], "grouped", "Quarter", "Revenue (million USD)", 240)

revenueTable3m = Table([
  Col("Quarter", ["FY2027 Q2", "FY2026 Q2"]),
  Col("Revenue (million USD)", ["96,221", "46,743"])
])
revenueTable6m = Table([
  Col("Period", ["Six Months Ended July 26, 2026", "Six Months Ended July 27, 2025"]),
  Col("Revenue (million USD)", ["177,837", "90,805"])
])
note = TextContent("Data are for the periods ended July 26, 2026 and July 27, 2025, in million USD. Source: NVIDIA official Investor Relations PDF, page 3.")
sources = [{title: "Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income showing revenue for Q2 and 6 months ended July 26, 2026 vs July 27, 2025.", sourceName: "NVIDIA 10-Q · Page 3", url: "https://investor.nvidia.com/files/doc_financials/2027/NVDA-2027-Q2-10Q-Final-including-exhibits.pdf#page=3"}]

sources.title: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income showing revenue for Q2 and 6 months ended July 26, 2026 vs July 27, 2025.
